Name: Perfection Shortcut
Author: yadm18
Description:
[heading]Perfection Shortcut[/heading]
Open the perfection tracker from your inventory.

[line]
[heading]What it does[/heading]
Once Qi's Walnut Room is unlocked, a gold star button appears on the inventory screen. Click it and the inventory closes. The game then opens the same perfection letter you get from the cat in that room.

The letter uses the game's own words, in the language you play in. It lists:

[list]
[*]Items shipped[/*]
[*]Obelisks[/*]
[*]Gold Clock[/*]
[*]Monster Slayer[/*]
[*]Great Friends[/*]
[*]Farmer level[/*]
[*]Stardrops[/*]
[*]Cooking[/*]
[*]Crafting[/*]
[*]Fish[/*]
[*]Golden Walnuts[/*]
[*]Your total[/*]
[/list]
It shows the same progress as the room, and it does not change your score. In multiplayer, each line still names the farmer with the best score.

At 100%, collect the Statue of True Perfection from the cat in Qi's Walnut Room. The button keeps opening the letter.

[line]
[heading]The button[/heading]
[list]
[*]It sits one slot to the right of the Community Center button. It stays there when that button is hidden.[/*]
[*]On a narrow window, where that spot would leave the screen, the star moves below the trash can.[/*]
[*]The tooltip is [b]Perfection Shortcut[/b].[/*]
[*]It is hidden before the Walnut Room unlocks, while you are holding an item, and while the option below is off.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[heading]Turn it off[/heading]
The button starts on.

[list]
[*]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], open [b]Perfection Shortcut[/b] and uncheck [b]Show the perfection shortcut in inventory[/b]. The change applies immediately.[/*]
[*]Without that menu, edit [b]Mods/PerfectionShortcut/config.json[/b] after the first launch and set [b]Enabled[/b] to [b]false[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[heading]Install[/heading]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this download into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b], or install the zip with Vortex.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
The mod folder should look like this:

[list]
[*][b]Mods/PerfectionShortcut/PerfectionShortcut.dll[/b][/*]
[*][b]Mods/PerfectionShortcut/manifest.json[/b][/*]
[*][b]Mods/PerfectionShortcut/i18n/default.json[/b][/*]
[/list]
[line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. It only adds the in-game checkbox.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[heading]More from Yadm[/heading]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53092]Guild Kill List[/url] adds the monster eradication list to your inventory. After you reach floor 100 of the Mines, Marlon writes. Visit the guild and he adds the list. You can use either mod on its own.

[line]
